title: Human ECoG speaking consonant-vowel syllables
description: High-density (256-channel) electrocorticography (ECoG) recorded at the University of California, San Francisco from epilepsy patients reading aloud consonant-vowel syllables. The dataset comprises 31 sessions from four subjects, organized as iEEG-BIDS with byte-identical NWB 2.0 files. It includes trial, syllable and artifact event annotations, and supports study of speech articulation and sensorimotor cortex function.
methods_description: Subjects undergoing clinical epilepsy treatment read consonant-vowel syllables aloud from a list while 256-channel ECoG was recorded at about 3051.76 Hz. The source NWB files were organized into BIDS without filtering, resampling, or re-referencing. Events were extracted from the NWB interval tables (trials, cv_transition, epochs, invalid_times).
